title: Snow White Princess
author: Keepinitkawaiidesign
description:
Definitely, the cutest in the land, this set of clipart illustrates the classic story of Snow White, complete with the evil queen, her magic mirror, poisonous apples, and all seven dwarfs. 
This clip art set is perfect for a teacher, librarian, daycare, or anyone needing to create a storybook setting. Put them on fliers, a handout, coloring pages – there’s a variety of uses with them! 
This set is available in both color and black and white, depending on your needs!
fullDescription:
Definitely, the cutest in the land, this set of clipart illustrates the classic story of Snow White, complete with the evil queen, her magic mirror, poisonous apples, and all seven dwarfs.

This clip art set is perfect for a teacher, librarian, daycare, or anyone needing to create a storybook setting. Put them on fliers, a handout, coloring pages – there’s a variety of uses with them!

This set is available in both color and black and white, depending on your needs!
